message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to the latest Gini coefficient figures. As of the most recent estimates (around 2019–2021), the United States’ Gini coefficient was roughly **0.41** (on a scale from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate greater inequality). For the absolute most up‑to‑date figure you might want to check the U.S. Census Bureau’s “Income Inequality” tables or the World Bank’s “Gini Index” dataset.
